prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1302; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss. Insured reports a collision at an intersection while turning left. Claimant's vehicle was struck on the driver side rear quarter panel. Police report requested. Scene photos on file, showing damage consistent with the reported impact.

Entry 2: Spoke with the insured by phone. Insured states the light had changed to green and they were proceeding through a left turn when the other vehicle entered the intersection. Insured accepts that a recorded statement will be needed. Scheduled follow-up.

Entry 3: Contacted the claimant directly. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the collision and says they were evaluated at an urgent care clinic. Claimant has not yet provided medical records. Explained the claims process and requested authorization to obtain records.

Entry 4: Received the police report. Officer noted both drivers gave conflicting accounts of the signal phase. Independent witness listed on report but not yet reached. Left a voicemail and sent a written request for a statement. Liability remains under review.

Entry 5: Claimant provided signed medical authorization and urgent care treatment notes diagnosing whiplash-type cervical strain. Physical therapy recommended. Set up a file review for injury evaluation and reserve adjustment. Will reassess liability once witness statement is received.
